name: Dick Palumbo
features: fair skin, grayish hair, dark eyes, british features, slightly fat build, mature features, clean-shaven, old man look
bio:
An Italian-American bruiser from New Jersey whose no-nonsense approach to racing leaves little room for pleasantries on track.

Dicky boy, as his friends call him, is the grandfather of all current active racers. Everybody respects him and no one, NO ONE, ever laps him. Whoever does that will be banned for life of racing.
